steps.title: Open Workday Developer Console
steps.detail: Navigate to the Workday developer portal (e.g., https://developer.workday.com) and sign in with your Workday account.

steps.title: Create a New OAuth Application
steps.detail: In the console, choose the option to register a new OAuth client, give it a descriptive name, and select the appropriate application type (Web, Native, etc.).

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Retrieve Credentials
steps.detail: Enter the allowed redirect URI(s) for your app, select the needed scopes, save the configuration, and copy the generated client ID and client secret for use in your application.
